name: Orbital Economy v7.7.3 Construction Materials Capital candidate r1
description: Task 013: construction-materials processing capacity becomes a kernel-v2 lifecycle-capital sector in each colony. Required capacity follows the smoothed Construction Materials Demand Signal to preserve same-step causality.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Capital Enabled
add_elements.description: v7.7.3 switch: enables construction-materials processing capacity as lifecycle capital.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Plant Operating Reserve Factor
add_elements.description: Required active plant capacity multiplier over the smoothed construction-materials demand signal.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Plant Installed Reserve Factor
add_elements.description: Desired installed plant capacity multiplier over required active capacity.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Plant Activation Time
add_elements.description: Days to reactivate mothballed construction-materials plant capacity.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Plant Mothball Time
add_elements.description: Days to mothball unneeded active construction-materials plant capacity.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Plant Surplus Disposal Decision Time
add_elements.description: Decision timescale before true surplus plant capacity enters decommissioning.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Plant Construction Time
add_elements.description: Physical timescale for closing an installed construction-materials plant capacity shortage.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Plant Decommissioning Time
add_elements.description: Physical timescale from decommissioning commitment to retirement.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Plant Depreciation Rate
add_elements.description: Daily physical depreciation rate of construction-materials plant capacity.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Plant Capital Goods per Capacity
add_elements.description: Capital Goods consumed per unit of new construction-materials plant capacity.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Plant Construction Materials per Capacity
add_elements.description: Construction Materials consumed per unit of new construction-materials plant capacity.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity
add_elements.description: Physical installed construction-materials processing capacity in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity
add_elements.description: Operational construction-materials processing capacity in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Decommissioning Capacity
add_elements.description: Construction-materials plant capacity committed to decommissioning in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Retired Capacity
add_elements.description: Cumulative retired construction-materials plant capacity in colony A.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Required Active Capacity

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Demand Signal] * [Construction Materials Plant Operating Reserve Factor]

add_elements.description: Required active plant capacity follows the smoothed demand signal, preserving same-step causality.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Desired Installed Capacity

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Plant Required Active Capacity] * [Construction Materials Plant Installed Reserve Factor]

add_elements.description: Long-run desired installed construction-materials plant capacity.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Inactive Capacity

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity]) + ((([A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Installed but inactive construction-materials plant capacity.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Target Active Capacity

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Required Active Capacity]) + ([A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity]) - (((([A Construction Materials Plant Required Active Capacity]) - ([A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity])) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Active-capacity target bounded by installed capacity.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Activation Gap

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Target Active Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity]) + ((([A Construction Materials Plant Target Active Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Positive activation gap.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Mothball Gap

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Target Active Capacity]) + ((([A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Target Active Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Positive mothballing gap.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity Shortage

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Desired Installed Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity]) + ((([A Construction Materials Plant Desired Installed Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Positive installed-capacity shortage.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity Excess

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Desired Installed Capacity]) + ((([A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Desired Installed Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Positive installed-capacity excess.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Gap Limited Construction

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity Shortage] / [Construction Materials Plant Construction Time]

add_elements.description: Maximum construction rate justified by the installed-capacity shortage.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Activation Queue Capacity

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Inactive Capacity]) + ([A Construction Materials Plant Activation Gap]) - (((([A Construction Materials Plant Inactive Capacity]) - ([A Construction Materials Plant Activation Gap])) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Inactive capacity already needed to close the activation gap.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Inactive After Activation Queue

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Inactive Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Activation Queue Capacity]) + ((([A Construction Materials Plant Inactive Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Activation Queue Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Inactive capacity remaining after activation needs are reserved.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Strategic Reserve Target

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Desired Installed Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Required Active Capacity]) + ((([A Construction Materials Plant Desired Installed Capacity] - [A Construction Materials Plant Required Active Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Desired inactive strategic reserve implied by installed reserve.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Strategic Reserve Capacity

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Inactive After Activation Queue]) + ([A Construction Materials Plant Strategic Reserve Target]) - (((([A Construction Materials Plant Inactive After Activation Queue]) - ([A Construction Materials Plant Strategic Reserve Target])) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: Inactive construction-materials plant capacity intentionally retained as strategic reserve.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Surplus Capacity

behavior.value: (([A Construction Materials Plant Inactive After Activation Queue] - [A Construction Materials Plant Strategic Reserve Capacity]) + ((([A Construction Materials Plant Inactive After Activation Queue] - [A Construction Materials Plant Strategic Reserve Capacity]) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2

add_elements.description: True surplus plant capacity eligible for decommissioning.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Lifetime Capacity Account

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity] + [A Construction Materials Plant Decommissioning Capacity] + [A Construction Materials Plant Retired Capacity]

add_elements.description: Lifetime accounting identity for constructed plant capacity.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Desired Expansion

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Capital Enabled] = 1, [A Construction Materials Plant Gap Limited Construction], 0)

add_elements.description: Desired construction-materials plant expansion; no finance limit, gated only by the v7.7.3 switch.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Expansion
add_elements.to: A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Capital Enabled] = 1, [A Construction Materials Plant Gap Limited Construction] * Min([A Capital Goods Fulfillment], [A Construction Materials Fulfillment]), 0)

add_elements.description: Actual plant expansion after physical Capital Goods and Construction Materials fulfillment.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Decommissioning Initiation
add_elements.from: A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity
add_elements.to: A Construction Materials Plant Decommissioning Capacity

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Plant Surplus Capacity] / [Construction Materials Plant Surplus Disposal Decision Time]

add_elements.description: Commitment of true surplus plant capacity to decommissioning.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Depreciation
add_elements.from: A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity
add_elements.to: A Construction Materials Plant Retired Capacity

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Plant Installed Capacity] * [Construction Materials Plant Depreciation Rate]

add_elements.description: Installed plant capacity lost to physical depreciation.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Dismantling Completion
add_elements.from: A Construction Materials Plant Decommissioning Capacity
add_elements.to: A Construction Materials Plant Retired Capacity

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Plant Decommissioning Capacity] / [Construction Materials Plant Decommissioning Time]

add_elements.description: Completion of physical decommissioning.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Activation
add_elements.to: A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Plant Activation Gap] / [Construction Materials Plant Activation Time]

add_elements.description: Reactivation of mothballed plant capacity.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Mothballing
add_elements.from: A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Plant Mothball Gap] / [Construction Materials Plant Mothball Time]

add_elements.description: Temporary removal of unneeded active plant capacity.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Active Depreciation
add_elements.from: A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Plant Active Capacity] * [Construction Materials Plant Depreciation Rate]

add_elements.description: Active capacity lost as installed plant physically depreciates.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Capital Goods Consumption

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Capital Enabled] = 1, [A Construction Materials Plant Expansion] * [Construction Materials Plant Capital Goods per Capacity], 0)

add_elements.description: Capital Goods physically consumed by construction-materials plant expansion.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Plant Construction Materials Consumption

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Capital Enabled] = 1, [A Construction Materials Plant Expansion] * [Construction Materials Plant Construction Materials per Capacity], 0)

add_elements.description: Construction Materials physically consumed by construction-materials plant expansion.
